codebaseData.name: Learnium
codebaseData.desc: Learnium is a Next.js 15 learning app that turns user topics into AI-generated microlearning sets and lets users chat with uploaded study materials through a Python RAG service. Supabase owns authentication and application data, OpenAI generates lesson content and chat answers, and Stripe handles subscription entry points.
codebaseData.code:
Next.js App Router
Supabase auth/data
OpenAI lesson generation
FastAPI RAG service
Stripe subscription flow

connections.label: Most app routes and server actions read the current user and persist records through Supabase.
Study buddy chat depends on the local FastAPI RAG service for document-grounded answers.

children.name: App Router
children.desc: The `app/` directory contains the user-facing route tree, shared layout, global styles, API handlers, and reusable UI components. It is the central surface where dashboard, set learning, study buddy chat, profile, auth, and subscription flows come together.
children.code:
app/
  page.tsx
  dashboard/page.tsx
  sets/[setId]/page.tsx
  buddy/[buddyId]/page.tsx
  api/**/route.ts

connections.label: Client pages call API routes for data loading and mutations.

children.name: Landing/Auth Shell
children.desc: `app/page.tsx` is a marketing landing page that routes users toward login and signup. Auth-specific pages and callback routes sit beside it, while `middleware.ts` redirects logged-in users away from `/login` and guards authenticated sections.

connections.label: The middleware refreshes Supabase sessions and applies route redirects.

children.name: Dashboard
children.desc: `app/dashboard/page.tsx` is the main authenticated hub. It fetches active learning sets, study buddies, and profile stats, then switches between set cards and study buddy cards with modal controllers for creation.

connections.label: Create controllers open modals that submit new learning sets or buddies.

children.name: Learning Set Flow
children.desc: `app/sets/[setId]/page.tsx` displays a lesson chain, selected lesson paragraphs, quiz modal, and completion flow. It loads set details from the API and posts completion changes when the learner finishes the final lesson.

connections.label: Learning set records originate from OpenAI output persisted by server actions.

children.name: Study Buddy Chat
children.desc: `app/buddy/[buddyId]/page.tsx` wraps the chat experience around a dynamic buddy id. The `Chat` component loads previous messages, posts new messages to `/api/send-chat`, shows a loading assistant response, and stores the final exchange through the API route.

connections.label: The chat route forwards user questions to the Python RAG API.

children.name: Profile & Plans
children.desc: `profile/page.tsx` summarizes account data, progress, completed sets, and plan state. `subscriptions/page.tsx` shows plan cards and drives the checkout route that creates a Stripe subscription session.

connections.label: Subscription UI enters Stripe checkout and reads subscription status from profile data.

children.name: API Routes
children.desc: The `app/api/` route handlers are the server boundary for browser interactions. They authenticate through the Supabase server client, enforce quotas, call OpenAI or the RAG service, persist user data, and return JSON responses to client pages.
children.code:
create set
create buddy
send chat
fetch dashboard/profile data
checkout/webhook

connections.label: Some API routes delegate database mutations to shared server actions.
Routes are the bridge to OpenAI, Stripe, Supabase, and the local RAG API.

children.name: Set Generation
children.desc: `/api/input-check` validates a topic description, handles daily set quota refresh/decrement logic, calls OpenAI with a Zod response schema, stores flagged prompts, and creates the full set/lesson/quiz database graph.
children.code:
OpenAI responses.parse
zOutputSchema
createSet(parsedResponse, title, description, category)

connections.label: The route requires OpenAI output to match the lesson and quiz schema.

children.name: Buddy Creation
children.desc: `/api/create-buddy` accepts multipart form data, applies the same request quota pattern, creates a study bot record, and stores metadata for uploaded documents. The Python service separately embeds the actual document content.

connections.label: The RAG service owns document text extraction and vector indexing for uploaded material.

children.name: Chat Bridge
children.desc: `/api/send-chat` checks chat quota, forwards the user message and buddy id to `localhost:8000/api/chat`, records both user and assistant messages in Supabase, then decrements chat quota through an RPC.

connections.label: The local FastAPI endpoint produces the assistant response.

children.name: Data Fetch & Progress
children.desc: The remaining API routes load sets, buddies, profile metrics, usernames, subscription status, and set details, plus mutate lesson/set completion and account state. They keep client components thin by centralizing Supabase queries behind JSON endpoints.

connections.label: Dashboard and profile pages depend on these routes for user-specific state.

children.name: Server Actions
children.desc: The `actions/` folder holds reusable server-side workflows for Supabase mutations and quota management. These functions are called from API routes instead of duplicating multi-table writes in each handler.

children.name: Learning Data Writes
children.desc: `createSet` inserts the parent set, lessons, paragraphs, quizzes, questions, and answer options from validated AI output. `createBuddy` inserts study bot metadata, and `storeBuddyDocuments` records uploaded document names and sizes.
children.code:
sets -> lessons -> paragraphs
lessons -> quizzes -> questions -> options
study_bots -> study_bot_documents

connections.label: All writes attach records to the authenticated Supabase user.

children.name: Quota Management
children.desc: `ProfileUpdates.ts` manages set-request quotas: decrementing remaining requests, resetting free/pro allowances, and advancing the daily refresh date. Set generation and buddy creation both rely on this shared quota logic.

connections.label: Set generation decrements and refreshes request allowance.
Buddy creation uses the same remaining-request budget.

children.name: Supabase Layer
children.desc: Supabase provides browser and server clients, session cookies, authentication checks, and all application tables used by learning sets, lessons, quizzes, profiles, buddies, documents, and chat history.

children.name: Session Middleware
children.desc: `middleware.ts` creates a Supabase server client with cookie passthrough, refreshes auth state on most requests, redirects authenticated users from `/login` to `/dashboard`, and blocks unauthenticated access to protected paths.
children.code:
matcher excludes _next/static, images, favicon
protectedPaths = dashboard, sets, profile, subscriptions

children.name: Client Factories
children.desc: `lib/supabase.ts` creates browser clients for client components, while `lib/server.ts` creates cookie-aware server clients for route handlers and actions.

children.name: RAG Service
children.desc: The `rag/` folder is a separate Python FastAPI service for study buddy documents. It extracts text from PDFs and PowerPoints, chunks documents with LangChain, stores embeddings in Chroma, searches a semantic cache, and answers questions with OpenAI chat models.

connections.label: Next.js calls the RAG chat endpoint from `/api/send-chat`.

children.name: Document Ingestion
children.desc: `/api/create-study-buddy` receives files and a buddy id, extracts text from supported files, splits the text into overlapping chunks, and stores chunks in Chroma with `buddy_id` metadata for later filtering.

children.name: Grounded Chat
children.desc: `/api/chat` checks the semantic cache, retrieves the three most relevant chunks for the buddy, injects them into a study-buddy prompt, invokes the chat model, then stores the response back in cache.

children.name: Stripe Billing
children.desc: Stripe integration is small but important: `lib/stripe.ts` exports the Stripe client, `/api/checkout` creates subscription checkout sessions for authenticated users, and `/api/webhook` validates incoming webhook signatures.

connections.label: The subscriptions page sends users into checkout and displays current plan state.

children.name: UI Components
children.desc: `app/components/` groups reusable cards, modals, nav, lesson views, progress widgets, and controllers. Components are mostly client-side and compose the dashboard, set flow, profile view, subscriptions page, and study buddy chat.
children.code:
cards/
controllers/
lessons/
misc/
modals/
nav/
study-buddy/

children.name: Creation Modals
children.desc: Controller components own modal visibility and delegate creation results back to the dashboard. The modals collect learning set or study buddy inputs, then trigger API-backed flows.

children.name: Cards & Lesson UI
children.desc: Card components render dashboard and subscription summaries, while lesson components render the chain/bubble learning interface. Profile and dashboard pages combine these with fetched API data.
children.code:
SetCards
StudyBuddyCards
StatCards
SubscriptionCards
LessonChain
LessonBubble
Progress

children.name: Schemas, Config & Assets
children.desc: The remaining project files define structured AI output, TypeScript/Next/Tailwind/ESLint config, and public images/icons. Static assets and lockfiles dominate scan LOC but do not drive application architecture.

children.name: AI Output Schema
children.desc: `app/schema/OutputSchema.ts` defines the expected lesson, quiz, question, option, and flagged-response shape. It is used by the OpenAI route to keep generated curriculum data structured before database insertion.
children.code:
lessons: { title, paragraphs[] }[]
quizzes: { title, questions[] }[]
flagged: boolean

children.name: Project Config & Assets
children.desc: `package.json` declares the Next.js, React, Supabase, OpenAI, Stripe, Redis, Zod, and UI dependencies. `public/` holds landing-page icons and default SVG assets used by the UI.

children.name: External Services
children.desc: Learnium depends on several service contracts: Supabase for auth/data, OpenAI for curriculum and RAG answers, Stripe for billing, the local FastAPI service for document chat, and optional Redis/cache code in the Python RAG layer.
children.code:
SUPABASE_URL
SUPABASE_API_KEY
OPENAI_API_KEY
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
STRIPE_PRICE_ID
NEXT_PUBLIC_URL

connections.label: The app's API route layer hides these services from most client components.

crossConnections.label: Dashboard fetches sets, buddies, and profile metrics from API routes.
OpenAI curriculum output is persisted through multi-table server actions.
Study buddy messages are answered by the Python RAG chat endpoint.
Middleware and route handlers share cookie-aware Supabase session handling.
Subscription screens connect users to Stripe checkout and plan state.
